verdict.rationale: A hands-on probe confirms Hatchet serves an llms.txt at docs.hatchet.run/llms.txt (HTTP 200) with a structured Hatchet Documentation header and summary. An agent can be pointed at it directly. The agent cookbooks (MCP, Claude/OpenAI Agents SDK) cover building agents on Hatchet, not docs meant for agents to read, so they add no credit here. missing for 10: evidence of the llms.txt content depth or coverage (e.g. llms-full.txt or per-page markdown), first-party docs describing agent-oriented documentation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: PROBE llms.txt: HTTP 200 at https://docs.hatchet.run/llms.txt # Hatchet Documentation
